svg.text: One write path, one feed, every session in one process
Every change is one transaction through one writer; after it commits, the store tells its feed, and each listener reads the store again
Events only wake: whoever hears one reads the store, so a missed event loses no work
JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket · paths of its own for attachments, uploads, files and terminals
Authenticate names a user the store holds, or the operator · one inbox in and one outbox out per connection
Reads run side by side, 8 per connection; everything else in arrival order · every notification carries its commit's seq
Deltas go straight to the feed
Usage rows, which tell no one
Four read-only connections, each on a snapshot
of the last commit; a read never waits for a write
and the gateway answers reads side by side
append-only log → threads · turns · items · tasks · workspaces · environments · model catalog · users · skills · memories · cron jobs · todos
One event queue, one dispatcher: told in seq order, deltas in between · it only wakes; the work waits in SQLite
Each step reads the view, asks agent.Next,
calls the model or tools, appends the result;
waiting on a person frees the slot
The deployment's catalog, kept in the store
and set by its operator; each user chooses;
4 calls at a time per model by default
Built-in · MCP servers · the embedder's own
Permission decided as each call is written
Run in the sandbox of the conversation's environment
invokes, read-only calls side by side
